theme: An open Friday — Halloween weekend with the girls, and a few holiday bookings to put to bed.
greeting: The day is wide open, Dan — nothing on the calendar, and it's the girls' last weekend with you before Sunday's handoff. A good window to finally clear the Christmas-travel bookings that keep sliding.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental is still open
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 board task to hold a full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has been overdue since mid-September. It's the hardest rental in that market over the holidays and it sells out — book it refundable now and adjust dates later.

needsAttention.title: December break destination still undecided
needsAttention.detail: All four girls, Dec 13 to Jan 2, with a decide-by of Sept 30 and book-by of Oct 15 both passed. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year and thins further each day — pick domestic or flexible-international and lock it.

needsAttention.title: ICGN Toronto panel is next week
needsAttention.detail: You're moderating Plenary 7 on stewardship data and reporting Thursday Nov 5. Jane and Andy have signed off on your run of show; Rachit is still working final question edits with his team, so nothing is owed from you yet — a good moment to reread the flow.

flagged.title: Two roles surfaced in your job alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged an Executive Director, Corporate Strategy opening at Estee Lauder and a Managing Partner seat at Synergy Management Group.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail — Black Friday previews, Guardian and Press Herald, sailing and travel promos.
inbox.clear: Nothing new is waiting on your reply; the ICGN panelists are reviewing your run of show.

recipe.title: Warm beet soup
recipe.why: Autumn's roots are at their earthy best, and beets make a warm, grounding bowl for the season.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Drive the Pathfinder down to St. Pete

acts.line: The calendar is clear and the girls are home — a slow breakfast with nothing to rush toward.
An open stretch; the two overdue holiday bookings would take only a small bite out of it and finally stop sliding.
Halloween eve in St. Pete — the last night of this stretch with the girls before Sunday's handoff.
